story.text: 매표소 앞에서 규현이 자유이용권 두 장을 흔들어 보였다. "오늘은 이걸로 다 타는 거예요, 아가씨. 각오해요."
story.reading: mae-pyo-so ap-e-seo gyu-hyeon-i ja-yu-i-yong-gwon du jang-eul heun-deul-eo bo-yeot-da. "o-neul-eun i-geol-lo da ta-neun geo-ye-yo, a-ga-ssi. gag-o-hae-yo."
story.en: In front of the ticket booth, Kyuhyun waved two all-access passes. "We're riding everything with these today, miss. Brace yourself."

story.text: 입구를 지나자마자 저 멀리 롤러코스터가 굉음을 내며 지나갔다. 나는 벌써 다리에 힘이 풀리는 기분이었다.
story.reading: ib-gu-reul ji-na-ja-ma-ja jeo meol-li rol-leo-ko-seu-teo-ga goeng-eum-eul nae-myeo ji-na-gat-da. na-neun beol-sseo da-ri-e him-i pul-li-neun gi-bun-i-eot-da.
story.en: The moment we passed the entrance, a roller coaster roared by in the distance. My legs already felt like they were about to give out.

story.text: "저, 저것부터 타야 돼요?" 내가 머뭇거리자 규현이 씩 웃으며 손목을 잡아끌었다. "무서운 놀이기구일수록 먼저 타는 게 국룰이에요."
story.reading: "jeo, jeo-geot-bu-teo ta-ya dwae-yo?" nae-ga meo-mut-geo-ri-ja gyu-hyeon-i ssik us-eu-myeo son-mog-eul jab-a-kkeul-eot-da. "mu-seo-un nol-i-gi-gu-il-su-rok meon-jeo ta-neun ge guk-lyul-i-e-yo."
story.en: "W-we have to ride that one first?" As I hesitated, Kyuhyun grinned and tugged me along by the wrist. "The scarier the ride, the more it's an unwritten rule to go on it first."

story.text: 안전바가 내려오자 심장이 미친 듯이 뛰기 시작했다. "규현 씨, 나 진짜 후회하는 중이에요!" 그가 옆에서 낄낄 웃었다. "그래서, 지금 내리고 싶어요?"
story.reading: an-jeon-ba-ga nae-ryeo-o-ja sim-jang-i mi-chin deus-i ttwi-gi si-jak-haet-da. "gyu-hyeon ssi, na jin-jja hu-hoe-ha-neun jung-i-e-yo!" geu-ga yeop-e-seo kkil-kkil us-eot-da. "geu-rae-seo, ji-geum nae-ri-go sip-eo-yo?"
story.en: The moment the safety bar came down, my heart started pounding like crazy. "Kyuhyun, I'm seriously regretting this!" He snickered beside me. "So? You wanna get off now?"

story.text: 트랙이 뚝 떨어지는 순간 나도 모르게 비명이 터져 나왔다. 하지만 내려올 때쯤엔 온몸에 스릴이 남아 웃음이 멈추지 않았다.
story.reading: teu-raeg-i ttuk tteol-eo-ji-neun sun-gan na-do mo-reu-ge bi-myeong-i teo-jyeo na-wat-da. ha-ji-man nae-ryeo-ol ttae-jjeum-en on-mom-e seu-lil-i nam-a us-eum-i meom-chu-ji an-at-da.
story.en: The instant the track dropped, a scream tore out of me before I even realized it. But by the time we got off, the thrill still buzzing through my whole body had me laughing nonstop.

story.text: "봐요, 결국 재밌어했잖아요." 그가 눈을 찡긋하며 내 헝클어진 머리를 가리켰다. 나는 민망함에 얼른 머리를 정리했다.
story.reading: "bwa-yo, gyeol-guk jae-mi-sseo-haet-jan-a-yo." geu-ga nun-eul jjing-geut-ha-myeo nae heong-keul-eo-jin meo-ri-reul ga-ri-kyeot-da. na-neun min-mang-ham-e eol-leun meo-ri-reul jeong-li-haet-da.
story.en: "See, you had fun after all." He winked and pointed at my messed-up hair. Embarrassed, I quickly smoothed it back down.

story.text: 해가 뉘엿뉘엿 질 무렵, 우리는 천천히 도는 회전목마에 나란히 앉았다. 시끄럽던 하루 끝에 찾아온 여유로운 순간이었다.
story.reading: hae-ga nwi-yeot-nwi-yeot jil mu-lyeop, u-ri-neun cheon-cheon-hi do-neun hoe-jeon-mok-ma-e na-ran-hi anj-at-da. si-kkeu-reob-deon ha-ru kkeut-e chaj-a-on yeo-yu-ro-un sun-gan-i-eot-da.
story.en: As the sun began to set, we sat side by side on the slowly turning carousel. It was a peaceful moment at the end of a loud, hectic day.

story.text: "다음엔 어디로 갈까요, 아가씨?" 규현이 능청스럽게 물으며 자유이용권을 팔랑팔랑 흔들었다. 하루가 다 가는 게 아쉬울 정도로 즐거웠다.
story.reading: "da-eum-en eo-di-ro gal-kka-yo, a-ga-ssi?" gyu-hyeon-i neung-cheong-seu-reop-ge mul-eu-myeo ja-yu-i-yong-gwon-eul pal-lang-pal-lang heun-deul-eot-da. ha-ru-ga da ga-neun ge a-swi-ul jeong-do-ro jeul-geo-wot-da.
story.en: "Where should we go next, miss?" Kyuhyun asked with mock innocence, flapping the pass around. The day had been so fun that it was almost a shame to see it end.

words.example_en: Have you ridden a roller coaster?
This ride is full of thrills.

sentences.en: Roller coasters are a bit scary.
Let's ride the carousel and rest.
Did you buy the all-access pass?
